declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} (u : Real) (A : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (b : Fin n → Real)
  (R : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (y x : Fin n → Real),
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)) u) 1 →
      Matrix.PosDef.{0, 0} A →
        Eq.{1} (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} A) A →
          Research.CholeskySolve.SolveTrace u A b R y x →
            ∃ ΔA,
              And (Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA) x) b)
                (And
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u n)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs R) i j)))
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0}
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u n)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs R) i j))
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 3 (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (Research.CholeskySolve.entrywiseAbs R) i j))))
